changeSet.author: orlando
changeSet.sql:
INSERT INTO base_permissions (name, code, sub_module_id, enabled) SELECT 'Modificar líneas de la suscripción', 'subscription.update', (SELECT id FROM sub_modules WHERE code = 'SUBSCRIPTION'), 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM base_permissions WHERE code = 'subscription.update');
INSERT INTO base_permissions (name, code, sub_module_id, enabled) SELECT 'Cancelar la suscripción', 'subscription.cancel', (SELECT id FROM sub_modules WHERE code = 'SUBSCRIPTION'), 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM base_permissions WHERE code = 'subscription.cancel');
changeSet.rollback: DELETE FROM base_permissions WHERE code IN ('subscription.update', 'subscription.cancel');

changeSet.author: orlando
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO base_role_permissions (base_role_id, base_permission_id, enabled) SELECT br.id, bp.id, 1 FROM base_roles br JOIN base_permissions bp ON bp.code IN ('subscription.update', 'subscription.cancel') WHERE br.code = 'ADMIN' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM base_role_permissions x WHERE x.base_role_id = br.id AND x.base_permission_id = bp.id);

changeSet.author: orlando
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO permissions (name, code, company_id, sub_module_id, enabled) SELECT bp.name, bp.code, ce.company_id, sm.id, 1 FROM company_entitlements ce JOIN sub_modules sm ON sm.id = ce.sub_module_id AND sm.code = 'SUBSCRIPTION' CROSS JOIN base_permissions bp WHERE ce.access_level = 'FULL' AND bp.code IN ('subscription.update', 'subscription.cancel') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM permissions p WHERE p.company_id = ce.company_id AND p.code = bp.code);
changeSet.rollback: DELETE FROM permissions WHERE code IN ('subscription.update', 'subscription.cancel');

changeSet.author: orlando
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO role_permissions (role_id, permission_id, enabled) SELECT r.id, p.id, 1 FROM roles r JOIN permissions p ON p.company_id = r.company_id AND p.code IN ('subscription.update', 'subscription.cancel') WHERE r.code = 'ADMIN' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM role_permissions rp WHERE rp.role_id = r.id AND rp.permission_id = p.id);
